斩！（斩！（第22页）历阳城并不大，但地理位置却很重要，类似风斗城，它是乞古拉山脉南端咽喉位置，所有去北方的人都要先在历阳城里补充好食物水等必须品，因为唯一一条进山的路就是从历阳开始的。与此同时，那充斥在天地之间猛烈跳动的心跳之声始终不曾停止，仿佛这天地就是一个心房，自己就伫立在心脏之中，每一次跳动都感受到那种撼天动地的力量搏动。不知什么时候开始淞婉觉得自己能够看得懂师父，没错就是看得懂，师父的一个表情，她就知道是什么意思。其实，撒贝一直都不知道，自从他第一次拿起赤明天帝时，剑身内部的那万千魔魂就在时时刻刻引诱着他堕入魔道。这座坟看样子刚刚修好没有多久，湿润的土地还散发着特有的腥甜。卿盏走上前去，在宋九灯光的映照下，终于看清楚了墓碑上的字。“这里就是炼剑师同盟的总部了？”夜寒轻呼一口气，就要走进其中。“还有，有件事情我想给你提个醒儿，你们最近发生什么敏感的事情？你知道傅伟，我听说他回來了，你知道吗？”郑琛珩对于这点是有些惊讶的，毕竟关于傅伟的事情他都清楚，这时候总是慎重的。“你不能留下，我忘记了你的责任吗？将养好身体，你就必须回到人间，好好守护人间。”清水皱眉。为首的黑衣人在跑出术士的一般攻击范围之后，提着的心终于有了一丝的松懈，他回过头看看身后，并没有人追来，这才停下了脚步。这二人不是别人正是匆忙敢来的曾毅和蓝怜儿，因为不了解此刻这里的情况，两人这才在这消息最为灵通的茶馆中喝茶，希望能够得到些有用的信息。

Cut! (Cut! (Page 22) Liyang City is not big, but its geographical location is very important. Similar to Fengdou City, it is the throat of the southern end of the Chigula Mountains. Everyone who goes to the north must first replenish food, water and other necessities in Liyang City, because the only way into the mountain starts from Liyang. At the same time, the sound of the heartbeat that fills the sky and the earth beats violently and never stops, as if the world is a heart, and he stands in the heart, feeling every beat. That kind of pulsating power that shakes the world. I don't know when Songwan started to feel that she could understand her master. Yes, she could understand the meaning of her master's expression. In fact, Sabei had never known it since the first time. When he picked up the Chi Ming Emperor, the thousands of demon souls inside the sword were always tempting him to fall into the devil's path. It seemed that the tomb had just been repaired not long ago, and the moist earth still exuded a unique fishy sweetness. Qingzhan stepped forward and looked at Song Jiu Ding. Under the light, he finally saw the words on the tombstone clearly. "Is this the headquarters of the Sword Master Alliance?" Ye Han took a breath and walked into it. "Also, there is something I want to remind you. What happened to you recently? Things? You know Fu Wei, I heard that he is back, do you know?" Zheng Chenheng was a little surprised by this. After all, he knew everything about Fu Wei and was always cautious at this time. "You can't stay, have I forgotten your responsibility? After you have recovered your health, you must return to the human world and protect it." Qing Shui frowned. After the leader of the man in black ran out of the warlock's normal attack range, he finally felt relieved. He looked back and saw that there was no one behind him. After chasing him, he stopped. These two people were none other than Zeng Yi and Lan Lian'er who came in a hurry. Because they didn't understand the situation here, they drank tea in the most well-informed teahouse, hoping to get some useful information.
